item.title: Middle East Eye: Israel targets apartment west of Gaza City, children amongst wounded
item.description: Israel targets apartment west of Gaza City, children amongst wounded An Israeli drone has targeted a residential apartment in al-Nasr neighbourhood, west of Gaza City, according to Al Jazeera citing medical sources at al-Shifa Hospital. According to the network, footage showed medics treating children with severe wounds following the attack. The total number of casualties remains unclear.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Could Britain defy Israel’s order to shut down its East Jerusalem consulate?
item.description: Could Britain defy Israel’s order to shut down its East Jerusalem consulate? Sir Vincent Fean, trustee of the British Palestine Project and himself a former consul-general in East Jerusalem, on Monday told MEE that “Israel’s threat to close the British Consulate-General is not just wrong - it is illegal”. Three weeks ago, Israeli foreign minister Gideon Saar announced the closure of the consulate as part of a package of retaliatory measures following UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband’s decision…

item.title: Middle East Eye: Yemen's armed forces claim 356 operations against Houthi targets over past day
item.description: Yemen's armed forces claim 356 operations against Houthi targets over past day Yemen’s Defense Ministry said that its forces carried out 356 operations against Houthi targets over the past 24 hours, claiming it killed and wounded 476 members. In a statement by armed forces spokesperson Majid al-Nuzaili, he said that a number of command and control centres, weapons depots and field artillery across 10 fronts.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Rubio meets with Saudi foreign minister for security talks
item.description: Rubio meets with Saudi foreign minister for security talks US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Saudi foreign minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud on Wednesday in Washington, DC., according to a press release by the State Department. The statement indicated that the two continued discussions from the UN General Assembly about bilateral cooperation on regional security and stability, including in Iran, Gaza, Lebanon, Sudan, and other regional issues.

item.title: Middle East Eye: Watch: Israeli forces set off large explosions in south Lebanon's Mansouri
item.description: Watch: Israeli forces set off large explosions in south Lebanon's Mansouri The Israeli military set off a large explosion in the southern Lebanese town of Mansouri on Monday, with Lebanon’s state news agency reporting that the blast was heard in the city of Tyre and several surrounding villages. Mansouri, located around nine kilometres south of Tyre and 10 kilometres north of Israel, and its surrounding areas have been subjected to several Israeli strikes and artillery shelling in recent weeks…

item.description: Iran says Qatar to convey US response after talks on ideas, IRNA reports Iran discussed ideas with Qatari mediators that will be presented to the US and expects to receive Washington's final response through Doha, Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Monday, according to state news agency IRNA, as a fresh push is being made to end the war. item.title: Middle East Eye: Trump denies he offered Iran sanctions relief for nuclear concessions
item.description: Trump denies he offered Iran sanctions relief for nuclear concessions US President Donald Trump on Monday denied he offered Iran sanctions relief and the release of frozen funds in return for nuclear concessions from Tehran. “This is untrue. I offered them NOTHING! Axios’ story, like most others, is a HOAX, used only for purposes of satisfying their Trump Derangement Syndrome,” he said on his Truth Social account. “They should withdraw this fake story, IMMEDIATELY!” he added.

item.title: Middle East Eye: UAE president discussed bilateral relations with Israel's Netanyahu, report says
item.description: UAE president discussed bilateral relations with Israel's Netanyahu, report says UAE President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan discussed bilateral relations with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu during his visit to the Gulf country on Sunday, the Emirati state news agency WAM reported on Monday. item.title: Middle East Eye: Saudi defence minister invites UAE vice president to kingdom

item.description: Trump 'surprised' UK freed air base suspects on bail US President Donald Trump said on Monday that British police should not have released on bail five men who were arrested near an air base used by the United States over a suspected attack. item.description: Iraq seeks US exemption from sanctions on Iranian airlines The Iraqi government has said it is in talks with the United States to seek an exemption from sanctions on Iranian airlines, which have disrupted travel for patients, students and pilgrims.
